newsitem.title: USA: Tidewater completes O.I.L. Ltd purchase.
newsitem.headline: Tidewater completes O.I.L. Ltd purchase.

text.p: Tidewater Inc said Friday it has completed a $535-million deal to acquire O.I.L. Ltd, a unit of Ocean Group Plc of the United Kingdom.
With the transaction, Tidewater, owner and operator of the largest fleet of vessels serving the oil and gas industry, will add about 100 vessels to its fleet, which now numbers 750, it said.

The diversified energy company said the acquisition is being financed by a $600-million credit line arranged through its principal lenders. Ocean Group's shareholders and regulators from the U.K. have approved the deal, it added.
William O'Malley, Tidwater's chairman, president and chief executive officer, said the acquisition will strengthen the company's presence in the markets of West Africa, Southeast Asia and Brazil.
